messages.name: anything
messages.digest: Convert a list to an array
messages.description: Convert a list to an array. The contents of the list will be placed inside the array, which will be sent to the outlet.

messages.name: append
messages.digest: Append a value to the end of the current array
messages.description: Append a value to the end of the current array. The array will not be output in response to this message. Useto force output.

messages.name: array
messages.digest: Make a copy of an array
messages.description: Make a copy of an array. The incoming array will be cloned and passed to the outlet.

messages.name: atoms
messages.digest: Output the current array as a list
messages.description: Output the current array as a list out of theobjects middle outlet. The elements of the array will be output as a Max list.

messages.name: clear
messages.description: Clear the current array. The (now empty) array will not be output in response to this message. Useto force output.

messages.name: delete
messages.digest: Delete an entry in the array
messages.description: Delete an entry in the array. The indexed element will be removed from the array (indices are 0-based). The array will not be output in response to this message. Useto force output.

messages.name: dictionary
messages.digest: Wrap a dictionary in an array
messages.description: Wrap a dictionary in an array. The dictionary will be placed inside of an array, which will be sent to the outlet.

messages.name: float
messages.digest: Convert a floating-point number to an array
messages.description: Convert a floating-point number to an array. The floating-point number will be placed inside of an array, which will be sent to the outlet.

messages.name: get
messages.description: Get an array element. The element will be passed to the rightmost outlet in the form.

messages.name: insert
messages.digest: Insert a value into the current array
messages.description: Insert a value into the current array. A new array element will be created at the index provided, with the supplied value. Any existing array elements will be shifted to make room for the new element. The array will not be output in response to this message. Useto force output.

messages.name: int
messages.digest: Convert an integer to an array
messages.description: Convert an integer to an array. The integer will be placed inside of an array, which will be sent to the outlet.

messages.name: list
messages.digest: Convert a list to an array
messages.description: Convert a list to an array. The contents of the list will be placed inside the array, which will be sent to the outlet.

messages.name: prepend
messages.digest: Place a new entry at the start of the current array
messages.description: Place a new entry at the start of the current array. The array will not be output in response to this message. Useto force output.

messages.name: replace
messages.digest: Replace a value in the current array
messages.description: Replace a value in the current array at an existing index. The array will not be output in response to this message. Useto force output.

messages.name: reserve
messages.digest: Reserve memory for a provided number of entries (doesn't resize array)
messages.description: Reserve memory for a provided number of entries (doesn't resize array). This is rarely needed, as the object manages its own memory and grows as necessary. If the desired array size is known, and re-allocation of the array needs to be avoided, this message can be used to ensure that theobject is pre-allocated to the desired size.

messages.name: shrink
messages.digest: Reduce memory usage to the current array object length
messages.description: Reduce memory usage to the current array object length. This is rarely needed. Theobject does not automatically shrink if its contents are removed or cleared, this message can be used to ensure that the object doesn't use more resources than necessary.

messages.name: string
messages.digest: Wrap a string in an array
messages.description: Wrap a string in an array. The string will be placed inside of an array, which will be sent to the outlet.
